name: mask-image
description: The mask-image CSS property sets the image that is used as the mask layer for an element, hiding sections of the element on which the masking image is set based on the alpha channel of the mask image and, depending on the "mask-mode" property value, the luminance of the mask image's colors.
appliesTo: All elements. In SVG, it applies to container elements excluding the defs element, all graphics elements and the use element
